findings.source_issue: Several examples omit prefixes or modal operands, give the wrong disjunction sign, and copy modal operators instead of the signed operand conclusions.
findings.minimal_treatment: Use the preceding formal tableau rules to restore matching prefixes, signs, operands and fresh/used conclusions in the explanatory examples; disclose the grouped repair.

findings.source_issue: The proof of existence of complete branches ends by saying all branches are closed, contrary to its proposition and the later use of an open branch.
findings.minimal_treatment: Say complete rather than closed and disclose that termination of the repetition is not independently established in this source proof.

findings.source_issue: The finite-Gamma proposition alone does not justify the unqualified Gamma theorem or corollary; the proof gives no compactness or infinite fair-branch step.
findings.minimal_treatment: Preserve the source theorem claims, state that the displayed proof step follows only for finite Gamma, and disclose the unresolved general-case gap without inventing a proof.
